pin_title: 6 Kitchen Herbs Ancient Egyptians Used in Medicine (Ebers Papyrus)
desc: Coriander, cumin, garlic, mint, onion and juniper all appear in the Ebers Papyrus, an Egyptian medical scroll from about 1550 BC. History, not medical advice. All 155 plant remedies in plain English in 'The Oldest Herbal'. #ancientegypt #herbalhistory #herbs #history #ebers

title: What Ancient Egypt Did With Honey
subtitle: The #1 Ingredient in Their Remedies
items: The most used ingredient of all
pin_title: What Ancient Egyptians Did With Honey: 3,500-Year-Old Uses
desc: Honey is the most common ingredient in the plant remedies of the Ebers Papyrus (c. 1550 BC): it sweetened bitter drinks, held pills together and was laid on burns and wounds. Safety note: never give honey to infants under 12 months. Read more in 'The Oldest Herbal'. #honey #ancientegypt #history #beekeeping #herbalhistory

title: Willow: The Plant Behind Aspirin
subtitle: Used in Egypt 3,500 Years Ago
items: Willow appears in an Egyptian wound plaster
pin_title: Willow Bark: the Ancient Plant Behind Aspirin
desc: Willow appears in a wound plaster in the Ebers Papyrus (c. 1550 BC). Willow bark contains salicin, the natural compound that 19th-century chemists followed to aspirin. A history story, not medical advice. From 'The Oldest Herbal'. #willow #historyofmedicine #ancientegypt #plants #history

title: Plants of Ancient Egypt You Can Still Grow
subtitle: Straight from the Ebers Papyrus
pin_title: Ancient Egyptian Plants You Can Still Grow in Your Garden
desc: Coriander, cumin, garlic, lettuce, mint, flax and figs were all grown or used in ancient Egypt and appear in the Ebers Papyrus. Plant a little history garden this spring. The story of each plant is in 'The Oldest Herbal'. #historygarden #herbgarden #ancientegypt #gardenideas #herbs

title: Frankincense & Myrrh in Ancient Egypt
subtitle: Their Most Precious Resins
pin_title: Frankincense and Myrrh: How Ancient Egypt Used Its Costliest Resins
desc: Frankincense and myrrh did not grow in Egypt; they were imported at great cost. In the Ebers Papyrus (c. 1550 BC) frankincense goes into ointments and wound dressings, myrrh into ointments and plasters, and myrrh was also used in embalming. More in 'The Oldest Herbal'. #frankincense #myrrh #ancientegypt #history #christmas

title: Ancient Egypt's Biggest Medical Scroll
subtitle: The Ebers Papyrus, c. 1550 BC
pin_title: The Ebers Papyrus: Ancient Egypt's 61-Foot Medical Scroll
desc: The Ebers Papyrus is the largest completely preserved medical scroll from ancient Egypt: about 18.6 metres long, 879 texts, around 80 conditions, written about 1550 BC and kept at Leipzig University Library since 1873. Its 155 plant remedies in plain English: 'The Oldest Herbal'. #ancientegypt #history #egyptology #historyofmedicine #books

title: Ancient Plants That Can Hurt You
subtitle: Safety Notes from The Oldest Herbal
pin_title: 5 Plants from Ancient Remedies That Can Be Dangerous
desc: Old does not mean safe. Castor seeds contain ricin, wormwood oil contains thujone, juniper berries are likely unsafe in large doses, aloe latex is a harsh laxative and poisonous autumn crocus looks like saffron crocus. 'The Oldest Herbal' gives a safety note for every dangerous plant. #plantsafety #herbs #history #poisonousplants #ancientegypt

desc: About 4,000 years ago the Egyptian vizier Ptahhotep wrote down his advice for his son. Five of his 43 teachings still hold up today. All of them in plain English: 'The Oldest Advice in the World'. #lifelessons #wisdom #ancientegypt #quotes #selfimprovement
